summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed to internal://payments-v2 (unreachable) at ~15:02:12 with no entry in recent_changes; the worker kept processing orders without recording payments.
recommended: Find who changed payment_provider_url to payments-v2 outside the change log, and add audit logging for config changes.
Make the worker fail or requeue orders when payment fails, instead of marking them processed.
Add an alert on payment provider failures.

The provider URL seems unreachable still — I should check the config logs to figure out which URL is actually correct.

payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
